title: Delivery clients
subtitle: Every recipient becomes a record on its own when the invoice is imported. Here you fill in the rules for the ones with a delivery window or a fee — the minority.

contractorMail.title: Mail with contractors
contractorMail.hint: The system sends the occurrence email and the charge email, and the reply comes back to a conversation inside the app — never to someone's personal inbox.
contractorMail.replyDomainHint: A subdomain of your own to receive replies, like reply.yourcompany.com — your domain's root MX is never touched.
contractorMail.apiKeyHint: The key needs to be Full access — a sending-only key cannot list domains nor read received emails. Leave blank to keep the saved key.
contractorMail.webhookSigningSecretHint: The Signing secret Resend shows when you create the webhook (starts with whsec_). Leave blank to keep the saved secret.
contractorMail.blockedReplyDomainInvalid: The reply subdomain needs at least three labels, like reply.yourcompany.com.
contractorMail.blockedWebhookSecretInvalid: The signing secret needs to start with whsec_.
contractorMail.blockedSecretsRequiredFirstSave: On the first configuration, both the API key and the webhook secret are required.
contractorMail.webhookInstructions: In the Resend dashboard, create a webhook for the email.received event pointing at this URL, and paste the Signing secret it shows here.
contractorMail.webhookPendingFirstSave: Save first to get the webhook URL.

checkReason.not_configured: The configuration has not been saved yet.
checkReason.credential_unavailable: Could not open the stored secret; save the key and the secret again.
checkReason.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Resend right now; try again shortly.
checkReason.provider_unexpected_response: Resend answered in an unexpected way.
checkReason.sender_domain_not_found: The sender domain is not registered on Resend.
checkReason.sender_domain_not_verified: The sender domain has not been verified on Resend yet.
checkReason.mx_absent: Create the MX record for the reply subdomain on Cloudflare, named reply, with the value Resend shows.
checkReason.mx_unreachable: Could not query the MX record right now; try again shortly.
checkReason.webhook_never_received: The webhook has not called the API yet.
checkReason.dkim_not_aligned: The reply arrived without DKIM aligned to the sender domain.
checkReason.dkim_unverifiable: Could not verify the reply's DKIM.
checkReason.dkim_absent: The reply arrived without a DKIM signature.

contractorMail.testEmailSent: Test email sent. The reply closes the pending items.
contractorMail.testEmailError: Could not send the test email: {{code}}

contractorContacts.title: Contractor email contacts
contractorContacts.hint: Who receives the address correction request and occurrence notices — chosen on every send, no fixed flag here.

form.deliveryFeeAmountHint: What the client usually charges, used to forecast the trip cost. The real amount goes on the charge, when it happens.
form.requiresSchedulingHint: A trip with a stop for this client is not dispatched while the appointment is pending or refused.

windows.hint: Several windows per day: the lunch break is the gap between two of them. The whole week is saved at once.
windows.invalid: There is a window that closes before it opens.
